rows.en: As special training, we will now hold a mock battle using melee attacks only.\nFleet Commander Vrlitwhai himself joins this mock battle. Defeat Vrlitwhai.
rows.notes: review: refit: L2 tighter; L1 unchanged

rows.en: Annihilate the Micronian mobile weapons\nthat have infiltrated the ship.
We captured Micronians, but enemy mobile weapons have broken into the ship.\nTo stop them retaking the captives, annihilate the Micronian intruders.
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording

rows.en: Annihilate the Micronian mobile weapons.
Ignoring the order to halt attacks on Micronians, Quamzin attacked their ship.\nWe can't let Quamzin get ahead of us. We're launching our own attack too.
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording

rows.en: To stop the contamination by Culture,\nerase the Micronian vermin.
rows.notes: Zentradi-side briefing; 'bunka' rendered as 'Culture' (capitalised, series usage); the contemptuous plural suffix rendered as 'vermin'. | review: term added to glossary

rows.en: Fleet Cmdr. Vrlitwhai, contaminated by Culture, made his own Micronian truce.\nWe cannot allow Culture to contaminate anyone else. Erase the Micronians.
rows.notes: 'Culture' as in row 326. Source uses an honorific-free report of Vrlitwhai's act; 'on his own authority' for acting on his own judgment. | review: term added to glossary | review: refit: "Commander" to "Cmdr.", "agreed to a ceasefire ... on his own authority" to "made his own ... truce"; L2 unchanged

rows.en: To make it home to Earth,\nannihilate the Zentradi forces.
As the Macross heads home from beyond the solar system, the Zentradi appear.\nFirst break their formation with reaction weapons, then annihilate them.
rows.notes: review: refit: restructured; "home to Earth" to "home", "preemptive strike" to "First ..."

rows.en: Capture the U.N. Forces pilot who is\nflying a Valkyrie without authorization.
We've spotted a pilot flying a Valkyrie around Saturn without permission.\nUnauthorized use of a Valkyrie won't be tolerated. Capture the pilot at once.
rows.notes: review: refit: "took a Valkyrie out without permission and is flying it" merged

rows.en: To rescue the hostages,\nhead to the target area immediately.
The Zentradi have taken Macross crew members captive. To rescue the hostages,\ninfiltrate the enemy ship and go at once to where they're thought to be held.
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording

rows.en: As part of your training,\nfight a mock battle against Max.
To prepare for relentless Zentradi raids, we'll now conduct special training.\nWin a mock battle against the rumored genius pilot, Maximilian Jenius.
rows.notes: Full name Maximilian Jenius kept as in the source. | review: refit: "the genius pilot everyone is talking about" to "the rumored genius pilot"

rows.en: Annihilate the Meltrandi forces\nclosing in on the Macross at once.
Bogeys believed to be the all-female Meltrandi forces are nearing the Macross.\nTo keep them from getting any closer, annihilate the Meltrandi at once.
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording, second Macross mention dropped

rows.en: To end the interstellar war,\ndefeat Golg Boddole Zer.
Peace with the Zentradi up in smoke, Boddole Zer attacks the Macross all-out.\nWe'll use the Minmay Attack to overturn hopeless odds. Defeat Boddole Zer.
rows.notes: review: refit: restructured; "overwhelming superiority in strength" to "hopeless odds"

rows.notes: review: refit: 'against' -> 'with', line break moved

rows.en: To prepare for emergencies like a Zentradi remnant revolt or unseen threats,\nregular U.N. Forces training begins. Beat each Destroid squad in mock battle.
rows.notes: Source uses the old U.N. Forces short form in the Macross Plus era; followed the brief's literal mapping. | review: refit: 'as yet unseen' -> 'unseen'; 'we will now conduct' -> 'begins'; 'fight mock battles... and win' -> 'beat... in mock battle'

rows.en: Annihilate the rioting\nZentradi remnants.
Rioting Zentradi remnants have ignored a call to surrender and still run wild.\nTo put down the riot at once, annihilate the Zentradi remnants.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'are still on the rampage' -> 'still run wild'

rows.en: To assess your aptitude as a test pilot,\nfight the Valkyrie squad in a mock battle.
rows.notes: review: refit: reordered

rows.en: This test assesses your aptitude as a test pilot for Project Super Nova,\nthe next main VF contest. Win the mock battle against the Valkyrie squad.
rows.notes: Source typo (next-machine for next-term) read as 'next main variable fighter'. Break kept at the matching point after the test-pilot clause. | review: refit: 'competition for the next main variable fighter' -> 'next main VF contest'

rows.en: Pass each waypoint as it is designated,\nas quickly as you can.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'Fly through' -> 'Pass'

rows.en: A flight test now begins to measure the prototype's thrust, agility and more.\nRun a time trial to measure how long you take to clear all the waypoints.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'flight performance, including thrust and maneuverability' -> 'thrust, agility and more'

rows.en: Destroy the targets as you\nhead for the target area at speed.
To test the prototype's agility, we'll fly it in a confined space like a base.\nRun a time trial: destroy all targets and reach the target area.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'like the inside of a base' -> 'like a base'; dropped 'as fast as you can' (implied by time trial)

rows.en: Destroy as many enemies as you can\nwithin the 5-minute time limit.
rows.notes: Source lacks a final full stop; added one for consistency with the other objectives.

rows.en: To gauge the prototype's combat ability, we'll now stage an arena mock battle.\nBattle a large number of targets, simulating combat against multiple enemies.
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording

rows.en: As a live combat test of the prototype,\nannihilate the Zentradi remnants.
We've had reports of Zentradi remnants appearing from a planet near Eden.\nWe'll now annihilate them, also as a live combat test of the prototype.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'planet Eden' -> 'Eden'; second mention of Zentradi remnants -> 'them'

rows.en: Stop the bombers escorted by VF-11s\nfrom reaching the target area.
rows.notes: Number of bombers not stated in the source; plural chosen.

rows.en: For prototype combat data in varied settings, a mock air battle now begins.\nDestroy the VF-11 and drone-escorted bombers short of the target area.
rows.notes: Bombers plural, as row 372. | review: refit: 'in a range of environments' -> 'in varied settings'; 'before they reach' -> 'short of'

rows.en: Destroy the carrier\nescorted by VF-11s.
For prototype combat data in varied settings, a mock sea battle now begins.\nSink the multipurpose carrier escorted by VF-11s, Destroids and an Aegis ship.
rows.notes: 'Aegis ship' kept literal; 'multipurpose carrier' for the general-purpose carrier. | review: term added to glossary | review: refit: 'Destroid squads' -> 'Destroids'; 'Destroy' -> 'Sink' (carrier)

rows.en: Destroy the base\ndefended by VF-11s.
For prototype combat data in varied settings, a mock ground battle now begins.\nDestroy the base defended by VF-11s and Destroid squads.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'in a range of environments' -> 'in varied settings'

rows.en: Defeat the rival aircraft in the competition.
For head-to-head prototype data, we now hold a mock battle against the rival.\nNeedless to say, it's the most crucial test for selection. Win at any cost.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'prototype against prototype' -> 'head-to-head'; 'rival model' -> 'rival'

rows.en: Subdue the U.N. Forces soldiers who have\nrun amok at the anniversary ceremony.
rows.notes: Commemorative ceremony rendered 'anniversary ceremony' (Macross Plus 30th-anniversary event).

rows.notes: As row 380. | review: refit: 'U.N. Forces soldiers' -> 'U.N. troops'; 'bring this emergency under control' -> 'end this crisis'
